description: Office of the Chief Secretary Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council - Extend the three month (03) period of Single person tribunal of Inquiry for Chairman of the Embilipitiya U/C
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns the extension of an inquiry tribunal's term for a judicial officer (a retired High Court Judge) to investigate potential offenses by a local council chairman. This falls under judicial/law enforcement matters as it involves the appointment and mandate of a judicial officer to conduct a legal inquiry, specifically under the Urban Council Ordinance.
